gbm_population_evidence.quote: Meningioma; Glioblastoma; Acoustic Neuroma; Brain Cancer; Pituitary Adenoma

candidate_evidence.quote: panitumumab-IRDye800 (pan800), a fluorescent, EGFR-targeted imaging agent

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects with intracranial lesions undergoing surgical removal as their standard of care will be eligible.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Participants will undergo immediate post-infusion monitoring, postoperative pharmacokinetic blood draws, and adverse-event assessments through surgery and a Day 15 (±7) follow-up.

role_evidence.quote: Pilot Study Evaluating Panitumumab-IRDye800 as an Optical Imaging Agent to Detect Intracranial Lesions During Neurosurgical Procedures

agents.drug_class_hint: EGFR-targeted antibody (panitumumab) conjugated to near-infrared fluorescent dye IRDye800, intraoperative imaging agent

coder_notes: Optical imaging agent for tumour visualisation only (diagnostic_agent), single dose before resection; no antitumour hypothesis. Glioblastoma is one of several intracranial lesion types named in conditions (also meningioma, acoustic neuroma, pituitary adenoma), so coded basket_gbm_eligible. Early Phase 1. Pharmacokinetic sampling is blood only. The two arms are dose cohorts, not a control.
